title: Map the real frontier of 3D ML for drug–protein systems
question: Which limitations of current 3D protein–ligand ML are genuinely unsolved under leakage-resistant, OOD, physically meaningful and experimentally relevant evaluation, and which of those limitations support a defensible research project?
acceptance_criteria: Evidence-backed taxonomy spanning structure, affinity, dynamics, physics, generation and evaluation
At least one strong counterexample against each major solved narrative
Leakage/similarity audit of dominant protein–ligand benchmarks
Map of receptor-flexibility and conformational-ensemble approaches
Map of physical failure modes: water, protonation, entropy, electrostatics and long-range effects
Prospective or experimental validation survey for 3D generative methods
5–10 candidate research problems with falsifiable hypotheses
For each surviving candidate: dataset, split, baselines, metrics, compute estimate, failure criteria and venue fit
Top 3 directions ranked only after red-team
